reviews.evidence: Declared "MIT AND OFL-1.1": the package code is MIT and the Inter font files are OFL-1.1. The fonts ship as separate font files the app loads, kept under OFL-1.1 and not relicensed; OFL-1.1 permits bundling with any software, and the FSF lists it as a free licence for fonts. The OFL text and Inter's copyright notice ship with the release (component asset:inter-font).

components.evidence: The repository owner. 2,527 commits authored as LeoPerez8 on the integration tip 2d95fbb9 (git log). The owner can license this code under GPL-3.0-only, except the third-party portions listed under port:*.

672 commits authored as Ygor Perez de Oliveira and 21 as ygor-infotera on 2d95fbb9, including the app icon commit 6fe6e6be. Part of this history shares an author address with LeoPerez8's, which doesn't establish who holds the rights. Needed: a written statement from this contributor (or of an assignment to the owner) that their contributions may be licensed under GPL-3.0-only.
165 commits, the "Release Wave <version>" version bumps and lockfile/format autofixes CI makes from the owner's workflows. Mechanical changes with no separate author.

1,976 commits carry a Co-Authored-By trailer for AI assistants (Claude, Codex, GPT), and one is authored as Claude. No third party claims rights in that output; copyright may not subsist in purely generated parts, which narrows what the grant covers but doesn't stop the owner from granting it.

components.licence: GPL-3.0 (Metrolist, no version-selection statement); NewPipe upstream GPL-3.0-or-later
components.evidence: Ported 2026-10-13 (a3f085e9) from Metrolist's app/src/main/kotlin/com/metrolist/music/utils/potoken/{PoTokenGenerator,PoTokenWebView,JavaScriptUtil}.kt and app/src/main/assets/po_token.html. The port didn't record an upstream revision. Metrolist v13.7.0 (7c5ba3ad22cb562d337897f82163a2b7fce665f3, the last release before the port) holds those paths; its po_token.html is identical to Wave's below Wave's 3-line header (upstream last changed in 98116669); its LICENSE is the GPLv3 text and neither it nor the README states "or any later version"; the ported files carry no headers. NewPipe v0.29.3 (8e15d04e) has the originals under app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/util/potoken and its README grants GPL-3.0-or-later. Every reading allows GPLv3, so the code can be part of a GPL-3.0-only work; the owner can't relicense it.
components.action: Record the upstream revision ported (v13.7.0 is the candidate the html matches) and give each file a notice naming Metrolist and NewPipe, their licence and that Wave modified it, with the date (GPLv3 section 5a).
components.notice: Metrolist contributors and NewPipe contributors, GPL-3.0 (NewPipe: GPL-3.0-or-later); modified by Wave.

components.licence: GPL-3.0 if derived (Metrolist, innertubex); MIT if derived (ytmusicapi)
components.evidence: Their doc comments say the response walk "follows" Metrolist's page classes (GPL-3.0), innertubex's AccountMenuResponse (GPL-3.0) or ytmusicapi (MIT), and YtClient reuses Metrolist's search filter parameters. No comparison against an upstream revision was made, so whether expression was copied is open. Compatibility doesn't depend on it: GPL-3.0 and MIT code can both be part of a GPL-3.0-only work.
components.action: Either credit Metrolist, innertubex and ytmusicapi in these files' notices as derived code, or record a comparison against an exact upstream revision showing only the response format was reused.
components.notice: Metrolist and innertubex contributors (GPL-3.0); ytmusicapi (MIT): credit if treated as derived.

components.evidence: Ported 2026-10-28 (0504b9bc) from shazamio-core tag 2.0.0 (5690a2e99ba2aa6456a742c5b1defd8e7841826b): LICENSE "MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 dotX12", Cargo.toml license = "MIT". HanningWindow.kt holds hanning.rs's literal table. Wave's comment calls the generator "itself SongRec's"; SongRec 0.8.2 (79d3d771) has src/core/fingerprinting/{algorithm,hanning,signature_format}.rs, Cargo.toml license = "GPL-3.0+", and shazamio-core's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md doesn't name SongRec. components.action: Carry shazamio-core's MIT notice in both files, and SongRec's GPL-3.0-or-later credit unless a comparison shows shazamio-core's code is independent.
components.notice: shazamio-core 2.0.0, MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 dotX12; SongRec (GPL-3.0-or-later) credit pending the comparison.
